items.vi: hundreds of people là số nhiều, quá khứ nên dùng were.

parts.instr: Write an email. Write 100 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Viết một email. Viết từ 100 từ trở lên.

items.q:
Read the email from your friend Kim and the notes. Then write an email to Kim using all the notes.

Hi! Our school is having a Food Fair next month and I'm helping to organize it. Which dish do you think we should cook? Can you come and help on the day? Also, what should we do with the food that is left over? Please tell me soon. Kim

Notes: suggest a dish and say why / say if you can help and when / give an idea for the leftover food.
items.sample: Hi Kim, thanks for your email. The Food Fair sounds like a great idea! I think we should cook vegetable noodles, because they are cheap and easy to make for a lot of people. Also, most students like them, and we can add chicken for people who want some meat. I would love to help on the day. I am free on Saturday morning, so I can come to school at eight o'clock and stay until the fair finishes. I can bring some big spoons and bowls from home, too. About the leftover food, I have an idea. We could put it in small boxes and give it to the families who live near the school. We could also sell the last cookies at half price in the afternoon. Please tell me what time we should meet. See you soon! Best wishes, Lan
items.vi: Trả lời đủ 3 ý trong ghi chú: gợi ý món ăn và lý do, nói có thể giúp khi nào, đề xuất cách dùng đồ ăn thừa. Viết đủ 100 từ với từ nối như because, also.

parts.instr: Write an article. Write 100 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Viết một bài báo. Viết từ 100 từ trở lên.

items.q: Your English teacher has asked you to write an article for the school magazine. Write an article about a festival or special day that you like. Say what you do on that day, what you eat and why you like it.
items.sample: My favorite festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival. It happens every year in September or October, when the moon is round and bright. In the evening, my family goes to the park, and we carry colorful lanterns. My little cousins run around and laugh, and the adults sit and talk. We also eat special food. My grandmother buys round cakes, and there are always fresh fruits, like grapes and oranges. The cakes are delicious, but they are very sweet, so I eat only a small piece. I love this festival because the whole family is together, and nobody is in a hurry. After dinner we look at the moon and tell old stories. It is a quiet and happy night. I hope that every reader can enjoy a festival like this with their family.
items.vi: Bài báo cần nêu tên lễ hội, việc làm trong ngày đó, món ăn và lý do thích. Dùng because và các tính từ như delicious, colorful để bài sinh động.

parts.instr: Answer the questions about yourself.
parts.instrVi: Trả lời các câu hỏi về bản thân.

items.q: What is your favorite food, and why do you like it?
items.sample: My favorite food is fried rice with eggs, because it is quick and tasty. My mom makes it very well.
items.vi: Nêu món ăn yêu thích và lý do với because.

items.q: Who cooks in your family, and what do they usually make?
items.sample: My mother usually cooks dinner, and my father cooks at the weekend. He makes good soup and grilled fish.
items.vi: Nói ai nấu ăn và thường nấu món gì; dùng usually.

items.q: How do you celebrate your birthday?
items.sample: On my birthday I have a small party at home with my family and a few friends. We eat cake and play games.
items.vi: Kể cách tổ chức sinh nhật; dùng birthday, friends.

items.q: What do you usually eat for breakfast?
items.sample: For breakfast I usually eat bread with an egg and drink a glass of milk. Sometimes I have noodle soup.
items.vi: Nói về bữa sáng thường ngày.

parts.instr: Describe the photo.
parts.instrVi: Mô tả bức ảnh.

items.q: Look at the picture of a street festival at night. Describe what you can see and say what you think the people are enjoying.
items.sample: In this picture I can see a street festival at night. There are many lanterns hanging above the street, and the colors are very beautiful. Many people are walking and talking together. I can also see fireworks in the sky. I think the people are happy because they are with their friends and family. Maybe they are enjoying the food from the stalls, too. I would like to be there.
items.vi: Mô tả bức tranh: có gì, mọi người đang làm gì, họ cảm thấy thế nào.

parts.instr: Talk about the ideas and choose.
parts.instrVi: Thảo luận các ý tưởng và chọn.

items.q: Your school wants to have a festival day. Talk about these ideas: a food stall, a parade, a cake contest, games for children, a talent show. Say which two ideas are the best and why.
items.sample: I think a cake contest and a parade are the best ideas. A cake contest is fun because students can bring their own cakes and everybody can taste them. Also, the winner gets a small prize, so people try hard. A parade is good because the whole school can take part, and children can wear colorful clothes. A food stall is nice, but it needs a lot of work. Games are good for young children, but older students may not like them. So my choice is the contest and the parade.
items.vi: Thảo luận các ý tưởng, chọn hai ý hay nhất và giải thích lý do.

parts.instr: Answer the opinion question.
parts.instrVi: Trả lời câu hỏi nêu ý kiến.

items.q: Do you think festivals are important for a town? Why or why not?
items.sample: Yes, I think festivals are important for a town. First, they bring people together, because neighbors meet and talk to each other. Second, young people learn old traditions from older people. Third, festivals are good for local shops and farmers, because many visitors buy food and gifts. Of course, they can make the streets noisy and crowded, but I think the good points are bigger. A town without festivals would be a quiet and a bit boring place to live.
items.vi: Nêu ý kiến, đưa ít nhất hai lý do và ví dụ, có thể nhắc mặt trái.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct picture.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn bức tranh đúng.

audio.t: What will Omar do at the camp on Friday?
Will you do archery on Friday, Omar?
No, I did that on Thursday. The canoe trip is on Saturday. On Friday I'm going climbing in the gym.

items.q: What will Omar do at the camp on Friday?
items.vi: Bắn cung là hôm thứ Năm, chèo xuồng là thứ Bảy; thứ Sáu 'I'm going climbing' (đi leo núi trong phòng tập).

audio.t: What did Lena leave at home?
Is Lena ready for the hike?
Almost. She has her hat and her sun cream, but she left her boots at home, so she will wear her sneakers.

items.q: What did Lena leave at home?
items.vi: Lena có mũ và kem chống nắng, nhưng 'left her boots at home' (để quên giày bốt ở nhà).

audio.t: Where will the friends swim?
Shall we swim at the beach on Sunday?
It will be too crowded. The lake is quiet, but the water is very cold. Let's go to the new pool in town.

items.q: Where will the friends swim?
items.vi: Bãi biển quá đông, hồ thì nước lạnh; cuối cùng chọn 'the new pool' (hồ bơi mới).

audio.t: What will the weather be like on Saturday morning?
Will it rain during the match on Saturday?
It's rainy today, and tomorrow will be windy, but on Saturday morning it will be sunny.

items.q: What will the weather be like on Saturday morning?
items.vi: Hôm nay mưa, ngày mai có gió, còn sáng thứ Bảy 'it will be sunny' (trời nắng).

audio.t: What does Tom want to buy with his birthday money?
Are you saving for a new bike, Tom?
No, my bike is fine. Dad will buy me a backpack. I want to buy a tent for the camping trip.

items.q: What does Tom want to buy with his birthday money?
items.vi: Xe đạp vẫn tốt, ba sẽ mua ba lô; Tom muốn tự mua 'a tent' (một cái lều).

audio.t: What does the girl's brother do every morning?
Does your brother swim before school?
He used to, but now he runs in the park every morning. He only cycles at the weekend.

items.q: What does the girl's brother do every morning?
items.vi: Trước đây anh bơi, cuối tuần mới đạp xe; bây giờ mỗi sáng anh 'runs in the park' (chạy bộ ở công viên).

audio.t: What is the man's favorite part of a camping trip?
Do you like fishing or watching the stars on camping trips?
Both are fine, but my favorite part is sitting by the fire in the evening and singing songs.

items.q: What is the man's favorite part of a camping trip?
items.vi: Câu cá và ngắm sao chỉ 'fine'; phần thích nhất là 'sitting by the fire' (ngồi bên đống lửa).

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: Why does Nora not want to join the swimming club?
Nora, are you going to join the swimming club?
I would love to, but the pool is far from my house, and my mother can't drive me there after school.
Isn't there a bus?
Yes, but it takes an hour.

items.q: Why does Nora not want to join the swimming club?
options: It is too far to travel.
items.vi: Nora thích bơi nhưng 'the pool is far from my house' (hồ bơi xa nhà) và xe buýt mất một giờ.

audio.t: What does the man think about the new climbing wall?
Have you tried the new climbing wall at the sports center?
Yes, on Sunday. I was a bit scared at the top, but the teacher was great, and I want to go again.

items.q: What does the man think about the new climbing wall?
options: He wants to climb there again.
It is too difficult for him.
items.vi: Anh hơi sợ ở trên cao nhưng giáo viên rất tốt và 'I want to go again' (muốn quay lại).

audio.t: What will they do on Saturday?
Shall we cycle to the lake on Saturday?
The forecast says rain. How about a walk in the forest instead?
The forest will be wet. Let's go climbing at the center.
Good idea.

items.q: What will they do on Saturday?
items.vi: Dự báo mưa nên bỏ đạp xe, rừng thì ướt; cả hai đồng ý 'go climbing' (đi leo núi).

audio.t: Why is the girl late?
You're late, Sophie. Did you miss the bus?
No, the bus was on time. I went back home because I forgot my running shoes.
We only have ten minutes before the race.

items.q: Why is the girl late?
options: She went back for her shoes.
items.vi: Xe buýt đúng giờ; Sophie 'went back home' (quay về nhà) vì quên giày chạy.

audio.t: What is the girl worried about?
Are you nervous about the ten-kilometer race?
Not really. I have trained for months, and I know the way. I'm more worried about the weather, because it will be very hot.

items.q: What is the girl worried about?
items.vi: Bạn nữ đã tập nhiều tháng; điều lo là 'the weather... very hot' (thời tiết rất nóng).

audio.t: What will the boy do about his skateboard?
Is your skateboard still broken, Ravi?
Yes. A new one costs too much. My uncle says he can fix it, so I'll ask him this weekend.
That's kind of him.

items.q: What will the boy do about his skateboard?
options: Ask his uncle to fix it
items.vi: Ván mới quá đắt; cậu sẽ 'ask him' (nhờ chú) sửa vào cuối tuần.

parts.instr: You will hear a guide talking about an adventure park. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Bạn sẽ nghe một hướng dẫn viên nói về công viên phiêu lưu. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: You will hear a guide talking to a school group at an adventure park. For each question, choose the correct answer.

Welcome to Pine Ridge Adventure Park, everyone. My name is Karl, and I will be your guide today. The park opened four years ago, when a local family turned an old farm into a place for outdoor sports.
First, some rules. Everyone must wear a helmet, and you can borrow one from the hut by the gate for free. Boots are different. If you did not bring your own, you can rent a pair for three dollars.

The morning is for the rope course. It has three levels, and the highest is twelve meters above the ground. Don't worry. Beginners start on the lowest level, and I walk with them. After lunch you can choose between mountain biking and kayaking on the lake. The bikes are very popular, so I suggest you book early. The kayaks are better if you want a quieter afternoon.

Lunch is at half past twelve at the tables near the lake. You can buy soup and sandwiches at the cafe, or you can bring your own food. One more thing. The weather here changes quickly, so keep a jacket in your bag. If it rains heavily, we stop the rope course for safety, but you can still have a go on the climbing wall in the barn.
We will finish at four o'clock with hot chocolate, and the bus leaves at half past four. Now, who is ready to start?

items.q: How long ago did the park open?
items.vi: Karl nói 'The park opened four years ago' (công viên mở cách đây bốn năm).

items.q: What do visitors have to pay for?
items.vi: Mũ bảo hiểm cho mượn miễn phí; còn giày bốt thì 'rent a pair for three dollars' (thuê ba đô la).

items.q: What should beginners do on the rope course?
items.vi: Người mới 'start on the lowest level' (bắt đầu ở tầng thấp nhất) và có hướng dẫn viên đi cùng.

items.q: Why does Karl suggest booking the bikes early?
options: They are free for early visitors.
There are only a few of them.
items.vi: 'The bikes are very popular, so I suggest you book early' (xe đạp rất được ưa chuộng nên nên đặt sớm).

items.q: What happens if it rains heavily?
options: Visitors use the climbing wall instead.
items.vi: Khi mưa to dừng khóa leo dây, nhưng vẫn 'have a go on the climbing wall in the barn' (leo tường trong nhà kho).

items.q: What time does the bus leave?
items.vi: Kết thúc lúc bốn giờ, xe buýt rời đi lúc 'half past four' (bốn giờ rưỡi).

parts.instr: You will hear an interview with a young sailor. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Bạn sẽ nghe cuộc phỏng vấn một vận động viên chèo thuyền trẻ. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: You will hear an interview with a teenage sailor called Dana Brooks. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Today my guest is Dana Brooks, who is sixteen and has just won a youth sailing race. Dana, how did you start sailing?
My grandfather taught me. He had a little wooden boat, and when I was eight he took me out on the bay every Sunday. I was frightened of the waves at first, but I soon loved it.
Do you train a lot?
Four times a week, usually after school. Before a race I also go to the gym, because sailing needs strong arms and a strong back. People think it is an easy sport, but it is not.
What was the hardest part of last week's race?
The wind dropped in the middle. We were almost not moving for an hour. I had to stay calm and think about the sails. That was harder than the rough weather at the start.
Who sails with you?
My best friend, Eli. We have known each other since primary school. He is good at reading maps, and I am better at steering, so it works well.
What do you do if you feel afraid at sea?
I breathe slowly and talk to Eli. And I always check the weather before we leave. If the forecast is bad, we stay on land. Safety is more important than winning.
What are your plans for the future?
Next summer there is a race across the sea to another island. It will take two days. I would love to do it, but first I must pass my exams. My parents say school comes first, and they are right.

items.q: Who taught Dana to sail?
items.vi: 'My grandfather taught me' (ông nội dạy tôi) trên chiếc thuyền gỗ nhỏ của ông.

items.q: Why does Dana go to the gym before a race?
options: Because her teacher asks her to
items.vi: Vì 'sailing needs strong arms and a strong back' (chèo thuyền cần tay và lưng khỏe).

items.q: What was difficult about last week's race?
options: The strong waves at the start
Staying calm when there was no wind
items.vi: Gió tắt giữa chặng, 'I had to stay calm' (phải giữ bình tĩnh) và khó hơn thời tiết xấu lúc đầu.

items.q: Why do Dana and Eli work well together?
options: They sail in the same way.
They are good at different things.
They train at the same gym.
items.vi: Eli giỏi đọc bản đồ còn Dana lái giỏi hơn, nên hai bạn bổ sung cho nhau.

items.q: What does Dana do if the forecast is bad?
items.vi: 'If the forecast is bad, we stay on land' (nếu dự báo xấu thì ở lại trên bờ).

items.q: What does Dana say about her exams?
options: She will take them after the race.
items.vi: Dana nói 'first I must pass my exams' (trước hết phải qua kỳ thi) vì bố mẹ bảo việc học đến trước.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

items.text: Sports Day. All students must bring a water bottle and a hat. There will be no lessons after 11 a.m. Parents are welcome to watch from the field.
items.q: What must students do for Sports Day?
options: Bring a hat and a water bottle
items.vi: Học sinh 'must bring a water bottle and a hat' (phải mang bình nước và mũ); sau 11 giờ không có tiết học.

items.text: Hi Pablo, the hike on Saturday is cancelled because of the storm warning. Coach Lee will call everyone on Monday to choose a new date. Bring your map to school anyway. Tom
items.q: What does Tom say?
options: The hike will be on Monday.
The hike will not take place on Saturday.
Pablo should leave his map at home.
items.vi: Chuyến đi bộ thứ Bảy 'is cancelled' (bị hủy) vì cảnh báo bão; ngày mới sẽ chọn sau.

items.text: Lake Beach. No swimming after 6 p.m. The lifeguards go home at 6. Children under ten must stay with an adult at all times.
items.q: What does the sign say?
options: Children must have an adult with them.
items.vi: Trẻ dưới mười tuổi 'must stay with an adult' (phải đi cùng người lớn); nhân viên cứu hộ về lúc 6 giờ.

items.text: Hi Maya, I found a cheap bike helmet at Gordon's Sports for $15. The sale ends on Friday, so we should go on Thursday. Can you meet me at the shop at 4 o'clock? Zoe
items.q: Why does Zoe write to Maya?
options: To ask her to buy a helmet for her
To say the sale has finished
items.vi: Zoe rủ Maya 'meet me at the shop' (gặp ở cửa hàng) vào thứ Năm để mua mũ giảm giá.

items.text: Junior Climbing Course. Starts on 3 October. Eight lessons, Tuesdays, 5 to 6 p.m. Shoes and ropes are provided. Ages 10 to 14. To sign up, speak to Mr. Ahmed at the front desk.
items.q: Who can join the course?
options: Only people who have climbed before
Any adult who has climbing shoes
items.vi: Khóa học dành cho 'Ages 10 to 14' (từ 10 đến 14 tuổi); giày và dây được cung cấp.

parts.instr: Read about three outdoor holiday camps. For each question, choose the correct camp.
parts.instrVi: Đọc về ba trại hè ngoài trời. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn trại đúng.

items.text:
Three outdoor holiday camps

Eagle Valley Camp: A cheap five-day camp for teenagers aged 12 to 16 who like cycling. You sleep in tents and bring your own bike. Every evening there is a campfire, and on clear nights the group lies on the grass to look at the stars. The price is $180.

Blue Bay Water Centre: A seven-day camp by the sea where you can try kayaking, sailing and swimming. Beginners are welcome, and there are free swimming lessons for people who cannot swim well. You sleep in rooms with beds, and vegetarian meals are always available. The price is $320.

Summit Trails: A three-day camp in the mountains with expert guides. Groups have a maximum of eight people, so everyone gets personal help with hiking and rock climbing. You sleep in a warm mountain hut. The price is $210.

items.q: Ali cannot swim well but wants to try water sports.
items.vi: Blue Bay có 'free swimming lessons' (bài học bơi miễn phí) cho người bơi chưa tốt.

items.q: Rosa wants to learn rock climbing in a small group with experts.
items.vi: Summit Trails có hướng dẫn viên chuyên nghiệp, nhóm tối đa tám người và dạy leo núi.

items.q: Jin has his own bike and wants the cheapest camp.
items.vi: Eagle Valley giá 180 đô la, rẻ nhất, và mang theo xe đạp riêng.

items.q: Toby only has a long weekend free.
items.vi: Summit Trails kéo dài ba ngày ('three-day camp'), vừa với một cuối tuần dài.

items.q: Sara wants to sleep outdoors and look at the stars.
items.vi: Eagle Valley ngủ trong lều và có buổi tối ngắm sao trên bãi cỏ.

parts.instr: Read the article. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Đọc bài báo. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

items.text:
My first mountain race
by Tomas Reyes

Last spring my sister Elena told me she was going to run in the Pinecrest Mountain Race, a ten-kilometer run up a steep hill and back down again. 'You should come too,' she said. I laughed. I played football twice a week, so I thought I was fit, but I had never run up a mountain in my life.

At first I wanted to say no. However, Elena offered to train with me, and I did not want to look afraid in front of her. So every Saturday morning we went to the hills behind our town. The first time, I had to stop four times in the first kilometer, and my legs hurt for two days. Elena did not laugh at me. She told me to walk when I was tired and to look at the view instead of the top of the hill. That small tip changed everything.

After six weeks, I could run for half an hour without stopping. I also learned things nobody had told me: you need shoes with a good grip, you should drink water before you feel thirsty, and a light jacket is a good idea because it can be cold at the top, even in spring.

On the day of the race, the weather was cloudy and there were about two hundred runners. I felt nervous and nearly forgot my number. The first part was easy, but after the halfway point the path became very steep and narrow. A man in front of me fell over a rock, and I stopped to help him. He was fine, and he thanked me with a big smile. I lost a few minutes, but I did not mind.

I finished the race in one hour and twenty minutes, which was not fast. Elena was waiting for me at the end with a bottle of water. She had finished twenty minutes earlier, and she was the one who clapped the loudest. I did not win anything, but I was prouder than after any football match.

Now I am planning to enter the race again next year. This time I want to finish in less than an hour and ten minutes. More importantly, I have discovered that I like being in the mountains, and I am thinking of joining a hiking club.

items.q: Why did Tomas agree to run in the race?
options: He wanted to win a prize.
His football coach asked him to.
His sister offered to train with him.
items.vi: Elena 'offered to train with me' (đề nghị tập cùng) và cậu không muốn tỏ ra sợ trước chị.

items.q: Which advice from Elena helped him?
options: Run without stopping in the first kilometer.
Walk when he was tired and look at the view.
Train every day of the week.
items.vi: Elena bảo cậu đi bộ khi mệt và 'look at the view' (ngắm cảnh) thay vì nhìn đỉnh đồi.

items.q: What does Tomas say about the weather at the top of a mountain?
options: It is often too windy to run.
It is always sunny in spring.
It can be cold, even in spring.
items.vi: 'It can be cold at the top, even in spring' (trên đỉnh có thể lạnh, kể cả vào mùa xuân).

items.q: Why did Tomas lose a few minutes in the race?
options: He stopped to help another runner.
items.vi: Một người ngã và cậu 'stopped to help him' (dừng lại giúp anh ấy).

items.q: How did Tomas feel after the race?
options: Proud, although he did not win.
items.vi: Cậu 'prouder than after any football match' (tự hào hơn cả sau trận bóng đá) dù không thắng.

parts.instr: Five sentences have been removed from the paragraphs. Choose the correct sentence for each gap.
parts.instrVi: Năm câu đã bị lược khỏi các đoạn văn. Chọn câu đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.text: Last summer I went kayaking for the first time. ＿ The instructor showed us how to hold the paddle, and after an hour I could go in a straight line.
items.q: Choose the sentence that fits the gap.
options: My brother has a red kayak.
I bought a new swimsuit that day.
The river is the longest in the country.
I was a little nervous at the start.
items.vi: Câu sau nói người hướng dẫn chỉ cách cầm mái chèo, nên câu thiếu nói lúc đầu cảm thấy hơi lo.

items.text: Our school has a new climbing club. ＿ Every Wednesday we practice on the wall in the gym, and the teacher checks that our ropes are safe.
items.q: Choose the sentence that fits the gap.
options: Climbing is very easy for everyone.
The gym is closed on Wednesdays.
It started in January and has twenty members.
items.vi: Câu thiếu giới thiệu câu lạc bộ (bắt đầu từ tháng Một, hai mươi thành viên), rồi câu sau nói về buổi tập thứ Tư.

items.text: My grandfather loves fishing. He goes to the river every Sunday morning. ＿ Last week he caught a fish that was almost as big as his arm.
items.q: Choose the sentence that fits the gap.
options: The fish he catches are always tiny.
He does not like rivers very much.
He sold his fishing rod last year.
He is very patient, so he can wait for hours.
items.vi: Ông 'very patient' (rất kiên nhẫn) nên chờ hàng giờ, dẫn tới việc bắt được con cá lớn.

items.text: I enjoy cycling to school in the morning. ＿ However, it can be dangerous when it is dark, so I always wear a helmet and a light.
items.q: Choose the sentence that fits the gap.
options: The bus is very slow in the winter.
I rarely go out in the morning.
My bike is older than my father.
It is quicker than the bus and keeps me fit.
items.vi: Câu sau bắt đầu bằng 'However' (tuy nhiên) nên câu thiếu phải nói lợi ích: nhanh hơn xe buýt và giữ dáng.

items.text: We went camping near the mountains last weekend. ＿ In the end we put the tent next to a small stream, and slept very well.
items.q: Choose the sentence that fits the gap.
options: The weather forecast said it would snow.
We had never visited the mountains before.
Dad forgot to bring our sleeping bags.
It took us a long time to find a good place for the tent.
items.vi: 'In the end' (cuối cùng) cho thấy trước đó họ mất nhiều thời gian tìm chỗ dựng lều.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct word.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn từ đúng.

items.q: Choose the correct word.

parts.instr: For each question, write one word in the gap.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, viết một từ vào chỗ trống.

items.text: We are going to the beach ＿ Saturday.
items.vi: Dùng 'on' trước thứ trong tuần: on Saturday.

items.text: If it ＿ tomorrow, we will play volleyball in the gym.
items.vi: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn (it rains), will + động từ.

items.vi: Sau so sánh nhất dùng 'in' với nhóm: the best ... in our class.

items.vi: Hiện tại hoàn thành với mốc thời gian dùng 'since'.

items.vi: Chủ ngữ 'I' đi với 'am': I am afraid of heights.

items.vi: 'A lot of people' số nhiều, quá khứ: there were.

parts.instr: Read the email and write a reply. Write 100 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Đọc email và viết thư trả lời. Viết từ 100 từ trở lên.

items.q:
Read this email from your English friend Alex.

Hi! My school has a Sports and Adventure Week next month and I have to choose one activity. I am thinking of rock climbing, swimming or cycling. What do you think I should choose? Which sport do you like best, and why? Have you ever tried a new sport that was difficult for you? Write soon! Alex

Write your email to Alex. Answer his questions and tell him about a time you tried a new sport.
items.sample: Hi Alex, Thanks for your email. Sports and Adventure Week sounds fantastic! I think you should choose rock climbing, because it is exciting and you can learn something completely new. Swimming and cycling are good too, but you can do them at any time. My favorite sport is badminton. I like it because it is fast, and I can play with my friends and my cousins in the park near my house. Last year I tried skiing for the first time on a school trip. It was very difficult because I fell over about twenty times! However, my teacher was patient, and on the last day I could go down the small hill without falling. I was so proud of myself. Please write and tell me which activity you choose. Best wishes, Linh
items.vi: Bài mẫu trả lời đủ các ý của Alex: nên chọn môn nào (leo núi), môn mình thích nhất và lý do (because), và kể lại lần thử một môn thể thao mới khó (trượt tuyết).

parts.instr: Write a story. Write 100 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Viết một câu chuyện. Viết từ 100 từ trở lên.

items.q:
You see this announcement in an English magazine for teenagers.

Stories wanted! Your story must begin with this sentence: When Jia reached the top of the hill, she could not believe what she saw.

Write your story.
items.sample: When Jia reached the top of the hill, she could not believe what she saw. Below her there was a beautiful green valley with a small blue lake in the middle. She and her two friends had been walking since the early morning, and their legs were very tired. At first the path was easy, but later it became steep and muddy. Jia wanted to go home twice, but her friends told her to keep going. Now she was finally glad that she had listened to them. They sat down on a big rock and shared their sandwiches and a bottle of juice. A little bird came and sat close to them, as if it wanted to join the picnic. Jia took a lot of photos, and then the three friends walked down to the lake. It was the best day of the summer, and everybody went home happy.
items.vi: Bài mẫu bắt đầu đúng bằng câu đề cho, có mở đầu, diễn biến (đường lên đồi khó, bạn bè động viên) và kết thúc vui; dùng các từ nối như 'at first', 'later', 'finally'.

parts.instr: Answer the examiner's personal questions.
parts.instrVi: Trả lời các câu hỏi cá nhân của giám khảo.

items.q: What do you usually do at the weekend?
items.sample: At the weekend I usually sleep late and then I help my mother with the housework. In the afternoon I meet my friends.
items.vi: Kể thói quen cuối tuần với 'usually' và các hoạt động đơn giản.

items.q: Tell me about a sport or a game you enjoy.
items.sample: I enjoy playing table tennis. It is my favorite sport. I play it with my father twice a week because it is fun and it keeps me fit.
items.vi: Nói về một môn thể thao yêu thích, tần suất và lý do với 'because'.

items.q: Do you prefer being indoors or outdoors? Why?
items.sample: I prefer being outdoors because I can breathe fresh air and move more. Indoors I often feel bored after a few hours.
items.vi: Nêu sự lựa chọn (trong nhà hay ngoài trời) và giải thích bằng 'because'.

items.q: Tell me about a place near your home where you like to spend time.
items.sample: There is a big park near my home, and it is my favorite place. I often go there with my dog and walk around the lake.
items.vi: Mô tả một nơi gần nhà, nói vì sao thích và làm gì ở đó.

parts.instr: Look at the photo and describe it.
parts.instrVi: Nhìn bức ảnh và mô tả.

items.q: Describe the photo. Talk about the people, what they are doing and how they feel.
items.sample: In this photo I can see two teenagers who are climbing a big rock on a mountain. They are both wearing a helmet and holding ropes, so I think they are careful. The girl is in front, and she looks strong and happy. The boy is below her, and he is looking up. The sky is blue, and there are green trees far below them. I think they are excited, but maybe a little nervous, too. It looks like a great adventure.
items.vi: Mô tả người, hoạt động và cảm xúc trong ảnh: hai bạn trẻ leo núi đá, đội mũ bảo hiểm, vui và hơi hồi hộp.

parts.instr: Talk together about the situation.
parts.instrVi: Cùng thảo luận về tình huống.

items.q: Your school wants to organize a day trip for your class. Talk about these ideas: a day of kayaking on a river, a bike ride through the countryside, a picnic and games in a park. Which is the best idea? Say why.
items.sample: I think kayaking on a river is exciting, but some students cannot swim, so it could be dangerous. A bike ride through the countryside is healthy, but it is very tiring, and not everybody has a bike. A picnic and games in a park is the easiest idea because everyone can join, and it is cheap. I think the park is the best choice because the whole class can have fun together and nobody has to be afraid.
items.vi: Bàn về ba ý tưởng, nêu ưu nhược điểm rồi chọn picnic ở công viên vì ai cũng tham gia được và rẻ.

parts.instr: Answer the opinion question.
parts.instrVi: Trả lời câu hỏi nêu ý kiến.

items.q: Is it better to play sports in a team or alone? Why?
items.sample: I think it is better to play sports in a team because you make friends and you learn to work together. When you lose, your team helps you feel better, and when you win, you can celebrate with everybody. However, sports you do alone, such as running or swimming, are good too, because you can choose your own time and speed. In my opinion, a team is more fun, but I like to do both.
items.vi: Nêu ý kiến cá nhân (đồng đội hay một mình), giải thích bằng 'because' và có ý đối lập với 'however'.
